theme: Rugby, Music, Bar Science & Local Legends

rounds.title: Round 1: Bar Warm-Up
rounds.hostVibe: Get the room energized! Welcome teams, tease craft beers on tap, spin groovy tunes.

questions.q: In rugby union, how many total points is a converted try worth?
questions.notes: 5 points for the grounding try, plus 2 points for the conversion kick.

questions.q: What popular shooter, famous across South African bars, is made by layering peppermint liqueur with Amarula or Cape Velvet?
questions.notes: Layers green and gold in a shooter glass.

questions.q: In the iconic 1986 action film Top Gun, what was Tom Cruise's fighter pilot callsign?
questions.notes: Pete 'Maverick' Mitchell. Goose was his RIO wingman.

questions.q: In cricket, how many legal balls are bowled in a standard over?
questions.notes: Wides and no-balls do not count towards the 6.

questions.q: What is the only mammal on Earth capable of true, sustained flight?
questions.notes: Flying squirrels and sugar gliders only glide; bats have true powered flight.

questions.q: What fictional city does Batman protect from villains like the Joker and the Penguin?
questions.notes: Superman guards Metropolis; Batman rules Gotham.

questions.q: In website addresses, what do the three letters 'WWW' stand for?
questions.notes: Invented by British computer scientist Tim Berners-Lee in 1989.

questions.q: In the classic board game Monopoly, what colour are the two most expensive properties, Mayfair and Park Lane?
questions.notes: The ultimate high-rent set on the board.

questions.q: What is the primary chemical element that makes up roughly 78% of the air we breathe?
questions.notes: Oxygen accounts for about 21%, Nitrogen makes up 78%.

questions.q: What colour is the inner bullseye on a standard regulation pub dartboard?
questions.notes: Outer ring is green (25 points); inner bull is red (50 points).

rounds.title: Round 2: The Beat & The Screen
rounds.difficultyText: Level 2: Pop Culture, Big Screen & Bar Anthems
rounds.hostVibe: DJ JC's home turf! Drop an audio riff or instrumental backing track between questions.

questions.q: Which Australian hard rock band gave us legendary pub singalongs like Thunderstruck, Highway to Hell, and Back in Black?
questions.notes: Fronted by Brian Johnson with Angus Young on lead guitar.

questions.q: In the 1984 sci-fi action classic The Terminator, what famous three-word line does Arnold Schwarzenegger deliver at the police station desk?
questions.notes: Delivered right before crashing a car through the front door.

questions.q: Freddie Mercury was the legendary, operatic lead singer of which British rock band?
questions.notes: Brian May on guitar, Roger Taylor on drums, John Deacon on bass.

questions.q: In the smash-hit 90s sitcom Friends, what is the name of the coffee shop where the six friends hang out on the orange couch?
questions.notes: Featuring Gunther behind the espresso counter.

questions.q: Which American rock band had a massive global hit in 1987 with Sweet Child O' Mine, featuring Slash's iconic opening guitar riff?
questions.notes: From their diamond-selling debut album Appetite for Destruction.

questions.q: In The Lord of the Rings, what was the original name of the creature who was corrupted by the One Ring and became Gollum?
questions.notes: He killed his cousin Déagol to claim the ring.

questions.q: Michael Jackson's iconic 1983 horror-themed music video featured dancing zombies and narration by Vincent Price. What was the song?
questions.notes: Directed by John Landis.

questions.q: Who played the Roman general Maximus Decimus Meridius in Ridley Scott's 2000 epic blockbuster Gladiator?
questions.notes: Won the Academy Award for Best Actor for the role.

questions.q: Which Norwegian band sang the 1985 synth-pop smash hit Take On Me, famous for its groundbreaking pencil-sketch animation video?
questions.notes: Fronted by Morten Harket hitting the famous high F-sharp note.

questions.q: In Quentin Tarantino's Pulp Fiction, what do they call a McDonald's Quarter Pounder with Cheese in Paris?
questions.notes: Vincent Vega explains it is because of the metric system!

rounds.title: Round 3: Rugby, Cricket & Sports
rounds.theme: Rugby, Cricket, Racing & Great Sporting Feats
rounds.hostVibe: Competitive juices are flowing! Remind teams that points start mattering heavily here.

questions.q: How many Rugby World Cup tournament titles have the Springboks won?
questions.notes: 1995, 2007, 2019, and 2023. The only nation with four titles!

questions.q: In cricket, what specific term is used when a batsman is dismissed for zero on the very first ball they face?
questions.notes: A diamond duck is out without facing a ball (e.g. run-out at non-striker's end).

questions.q: In a rugby union starting lineup, which position wears the number 15 jersey on the pitch?
questions.notes: The last line of defense (e.g. Percy Montgomery, Damian Willemse).

questions.q: Who holds the all-time world record for the highest individual score in a single Test match innings with 400 runs not out?
questions.notes: Scored against England in Antigua in April 2004.

questions.q: Which German racing legend won five consecutive Formula 1 World Championships with Ferrari between 2000 and 2004?
questions.notes: Won 7 world drivers championships in total.

questions.q: In the 1995 Rugby World Cup final at Ellis Park, which Springbok flyhalf kicked the winning drop goal in extra time against the All Blacks?
questions.notes: Final score was 15-12 in historic extra time.

questions.q: In the 1992 Cricket World Cup, which South African fielder produced the most famous run-out in history by diving horizontal through the air to shatter the stumps against Pakistan?
questions.notes: Dismissing Inzamam-ul-Haq in Brisbane.

questions.q: Known as 'The Greatest', which legendary heavyweight boxing champion famously coined the phrase 'Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee'?
questions.notes: Defeated George Foreman in the Rumble in the Jungle.

questions.q: How many major golf championships has Tiger Woods won in his career so far?
questions.notes: Second only to Jack Nicklaus with 18.

questions.q: Alongside captain Siya Kolisi, who served as head coach when the Springboks won the 2019 Rugby World Cup in Japan?
questions.notes: Johan 'Rassie' Erasmus led the Boks to a 32-12 triumph over England.

rounds.title: Round 4: Around The World & Bar Science
rounds.difficultyText: Level 4: Craft Beer Mastery & Scientific Curiosity
rounds.hostVibe: Tailored specifically for Beerbox Midrand! Craft beer lovers and foodies will shine here.

questions.q: What is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth, covering more than 30% of the planet's surface?
questions.notes: Larger than all Earth's landmass combined.

questions.q: What natural flower cone provides beer with its characteristic bitterness, aroma, and head retention during brewing?
questions.notes: The four main beer ingredients: Water, Malt, Hops, Yeast.

questions.q: In which European capital city would you find the ancient Roman Colosseum?
questions.notes: Completed in 80 AD under Emperor Titus.

questions.q: How many total bones are in a typical adult human skeleton?
questions.notes: Babies start with ~270 bones which fuse into 206 as adults.

questions.q: What is the fastest land animal on Earth, capable of sprinting over 100 km/h in short bursts?
questions.notes: Can accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in roughly 3 seconds.

questions.q: What is the cardinal, golden rule of cooking a traditional potjiekos once the heavy cast-iron lid is closed over the coals?
options: C) You never stir the pot
questions.a: C) You never stir the pot
questions.notes: The layered ingredients must cook undisturbed.

questions.q: Which planet in our solar system is nicknamed the 'Red Planet' due to iron oxide rust covering its surface?
questions.notes: Fourth planet from the sun.

questions.q: What botanical berry gives Gin its signature required flavor profile?
questions.notes: Without juniper, it legally cannot be called gin.

questions.q: What is the official federal capital city of Australia?
questions.notes: Purpose-built capital chosen as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.q: What three classic fillings make up the holy trinity inside an authentic braaibroodjie alongside cheddar cheese?
questions.notes: With butter on the outside of the bread for that perfect braai crust.

rounds.title: Round 5: Pub Mastermind Decider
rounds.hostVibe: Tension is at its peak! Announce the top 3 teams on the mic before firing these off.

questions.q: In The Lord of the Rings trilogy, what is the name of the fiery volcano in Mordor where Frodo must cast the One Ring to destroy it?
questions.notes: Also called Orodruin in Elvish.

questions.q: In a standard game of English pub darts, what is the maximum mathematical score a player can achieve in a single turn of three darts?
questions.notes: Three treble 20s. DJ JC: Hit them with a big 'ONE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY!'

questions.q: In what calendar year did the Berlin Wall fall, initiating the reunification of Germany and end of the Cold War?
questions.notes: November 9, 1989.

questions.q: In modern computer hardware and mobile device cables, what does the abbreviation 'USB' stand for?
questions.notes: Introduced in 1996.

questions.q: Which legendary English rock guitarist was nicknamed 'Slowhand' and played with The Yardbirds, Cream, and recorded solo hits like Layla and Wonderful Tonight?
questions.notes: Inducted three times into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

questions.q: What is the distinctive and flamboyant collective English noun for a group or flock of flamingos?
questions.notes: A flamboyance of flamingos.

questions.q: What is the name of the deepest surveyed oceanic trench on planet Earth, located in the western Pacific Ocean?
questions.notes: Plunges down nearly 11,000 meters in Challenger Deep.

questions.q: Who directed the iconic Hollywood blockbusters Jaws, Jurassic Park, Raiders of the Lost Ark, and Saving Private Ryan?
questions.notes: The most commercially successful director in film history.

questions.q: What three alcoholic ingredients are mixed in equal parts to create a classic Italian Negroni cocktail?
questions.notes: 1:1:1 ratio, traditionally garnished with an orange peel.

questions.q: South Africa has three official capital cities: Pretoria (Executive) and Cape Town (Legislative). Which city is the Judicial capital?
questions.notes: Located in the Free State; seat of the Supreme Court of Appeal.

rounds.title: Sudden-Death Tie-Breakers
rounds.hostVibe: Have tied team captains write down a single numeric estimate on paper. Closest number takes 1st place!

questions.q: How many meters high is Table Mountain above sea level at its highest point (Maclear's Beacon)?
questions.notes: Maclear's Beacon is 1,086 meters above sea level.

questions.q: In what calendar year did the original Sony PlayStation console first release in South Africa and Europe?
questions.notes: September 1995 in Europe/SA.

questions.q: How many total matches were played across the entire 2023 Rugby World Cup tournament in France?
questions.notes: 40 pool matches + 8 knockout games.
